name: unified-ft: one Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 LoRA that turns a raw user sentence (Romanian, mixed, badly written or correct English) into limited English in one call (u2: faithful English then limited English; u1: limited English only), against the two-step chain (translate or LanguageProofingLLM, then the gated SymbolicProofingLLM it3, then SymbolicLM)
registered_by: unified-ft-agent-b (owner decision in status/journal.jsonl, actor orchestrator, 2026-10-01T13:29:04.491Z; scope status/training/owner-approval-unified-qwen3-4b-u2.json)
owner_request: Aprob antrenarea Qwen3-4B unificat (LoRA, 1 epocă, varianta u2, apoi u1 dacă u2 arată promițător) pentru experimentul unified-ft. (owner, chat, 2026-10-01; the full message also asked: fa cu grija, masoara totul si compara sa fim siguri)
frozen_before_results: Written after the dataset qualifications and the u2 authorization receipt and before any optimizer step of this run and before any output of any unified checkpoint on any set. The chain arm was generated by the previous agent before this record (natural set outputs, CPU, Q4_K_M Qwen3-4B first layer, it3 F16 rewrite); no unified output existed then, and no chain number was looked at when the thresholds below were set.
questions: Q1: Does one 4B model that maps the raw sentence straight to limited English keep the user's meaning and give SymbolicLM-certified sentences as often as the two-step chain, per sentence and per message, on the 425 natural sentences of the 226 owner messages?
Q2: Does it do so without more silent meaning changes (S3+ with no marker) and without more catastrophic changes (S4)?
Q3: Does the same hold on English tangled sentences (the sealed decomposition suite, 275) and on the sealed neuro repair pairs (300 sampled)?
Q4: What do the second output (u2 faithful line) and training on one output only (u1) cost or gain, and what does a call cost on a laptop CPU compared with the chain?

hypotheses.H1: Main metric, natural set, per sentence: certified AND meaning kept (upper estimate = the worse of the Grok and GLM verdicts is S0-S2, SymbolicLM certifies every sentence of the output): u2 minus chain, paired bootstrap 95% interval over the same sentences, has its lower bound at or above -3 pp (non-inferiority). A clear win is a lower bound above 0.
hypotheses.H2: No new catastrophic class: u2 minus chain in S4 (upper) and in firm silent S3+ (both judges S3+, no marker) has an upper interval bound of at most +2 pp on the natural set, and both are at most +2 pp on the decomposition and neuro sets.
hypotheses.H3: Same as H1 per message of the natural set (the sentences of a message joined) and on the decomposition and neuro sets per case (non-inferiority margin -3 pp on each).
hypotheses.H4: Stability: at most 2% of the outputs of any set miss the output format (u2: faithful: then limited:), at most 1% are empty or hit the cap, no repeated sentence loops.
hypotheses.H5: Cost: the median CPU latency per sentence (llama-server, 4 threads, Q4_K_M, one request) of u2 is reported against the chain (first layer + rewrite call, as measured in the same harness); no threshold, it decides nothing alone.
hypotheses.H6: u1 (only if u2 is promising): u1 minus u2 on the same measures, same rule; reported as a separate arm.
hypotheses.non_claim: No claim about forms of sentences outside the training forms, about the SOP layer, about a model other than this base and size, or about the owner's real traffic beyond the 226 messages. A case on which the two judges disagree on S3/S4 is excusable ambiguity: reported apart (firm and upper numbers side by side), never counted as a model failure.

arms.name: chain
arms.detail: first layer = the Qwen3-4B Q4_K_M translate arm of translate-compare (natural set) or LanguageProofingLLM prod1 through textToCleanEnglish (decomposition and neuro sets); then the gated SymbolicProofingLLM it3 rewrite (F16 GGUF, certified acceptance); then SymbolicLM certification. CPU, llama-server.

arms.name: u1
arms.kind: training arm, only if u2 is promising

changed_factor: One-call unified model against the two-step chain; u1 against u2 changes only the target (one output instead of two). Same base, recipe, rows and seed.

data.sources: datasets/neuro_english/proofing-it3-mix (neuro repairs and identities), datasets/symbolic_english (identity), bad_english proofing-prod1 pairs (Romanian, mixed, noisy), each limited English certified by SymbolicLM (tools/research/unified-ft-certify.mjs for the extra rows)
data.tokens: train u2 1,658,613 (max 282), u1 1,118,585 (max 188), nothing over max_length 512
data.guards: 0 sealed leaks (eval/suites), 0 natural-overlap rows (the 226 owner messages are never trained on), jargon blocklist 176 terms 0 rows, 0 duplicate prompts or ids; dev holds whole source groups (472 rows moved by group) and Romanian, mixed and noisy rows: dev neuro ro 118, mixed 106, noisy_en 53, symbolic ro 63, mixed 63, certified ro 18

recipe_policy.mode: LoRA r16 alpha32 dropout 0.05, lr 1e-4, micro-batch 8 x accumulation 2 (effective 16), 1 epoch (1,535 optimizer steps), max_length 512, sdpa, bf16 autocast, seed 42 (config/train-qwen3-4b.json)
recipe_policy.snapshots: latest every 600 steps, epoch-1 and best at the end
recipe_policy.resources: Podman job (training/container/podman.mjs) under the single-GPU-worker lock, alone on the GPU, wall cap 150 minutes; no other process is killed; CPU-only inference of the other agents may run, and then CPU latencies are measured only when the CPU is idle

early_stopping.training: Interim text checks (training/python/train.py, additive, role proofreader) at 1/3, 2/3 of the epoch and at the end: dev loss and a greedy decode of 150 dev rows stratified by language kind; stop as failing from 0.6 epochs on when more than 20% of the sample is empty or capped or fewer than 10% match the limited target; also non-finite loss, OOM, resource floor, wall cap. A smoke run of 4 steps with 24 dev rows (run unified-qwen3-4b-u2-smoke, same approval) proves the check before the real run.
early_stopping.evaluation: Staged on stratified samples with a paired bootstrap interval after each stage: natural 60 messages, then 150, then all 226; decomposition 100 then 275; neuro 100 then 300. Stop and do not train u1 when, after a stage of at least 60 messages, the u2-minus-chain interval of H1 lies entirely below -5 pp (futility), or when the condition is broken (more than 20% unparsable or empty outputs on the first 100 outputs). Stop evaluating (promising, go on to u1) only after the full natural set; a decisive result earlier skips the later stage of the same set but never the other sets.

evaluation.harness: tools/eval/unified-ft/run.mjs (gen, final, pairs, report); judges Grok (xai-oauth/grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning) and GLM (zai/glm-5.3-flash), upper = the worse, lower = the milder; local severity cascade first on the English sets; judge disagreement reported apart.
evaluation.metrics: certified and meaning kept (upper and lower), certified, kept, S4 (upper and firm), silent S3+ (upper and firm), excusable S3+, marked, format failures, per sentence and per message; paired bootstrap (2000 resamples, seed 7) of every flag; median CPU latency and token counts.
evaluation.gguf: merged bf16, F16 GGUF, Q4_K_M by llama.cpp (~/llama-cpp-venv); the arm evaluated is Q4_K_M, as the chain's first layer is.
evaluation.cost: training seconds and GPU hours, judge calls, CPU ms per call.

decision_rule: Promising (go on to u1) = H1 and H2 hold on the natural set and H4 holds. Recommendation 'chain wins' if H1 or H2 fails; 'u2 equivalent, one call' if H1-H4 hold with lower bound at or below 0; 'u2 clearly better' if the H1 lower bound is above 0 and H2 holds. This run recommends, never switches: config/formalizers.json is NOT edited; the orchestrator decides with the owner.
non_goals: no rule changes in lib/ud-to-sop, no tuning on a sealed file, no other fine-tuning, no change of config/formalizers.json, no third run
